Concurrently, initial jobless claims in the US decreased by 6,000 to 189,000 for the week ending October 31. The move comes as global equities faced selling pressure and oil prices trended upward. Indian markets often track US yield movements as they influence foreign institutional investor flows.

rows.headline: AI sector growth obscures South Korea's economic weaknesses

While headline growth figures appear robust, underlying domestic consumption and non-tech manufacturing sectors are struggling. This divergence creates a fragile economic picture that relies heavily on a single industry. For Indian investors, this highlights the risks of relying on global tech cycles to gauge the health of export-oriented Asian economies.

This impacts retail and institutional traders who use currency derivatives primarily for hedging or speculation.

rows.hook: Volatility spikes as AI rally falters
rows.summary: The CBOE Volatility Index (VIX), often called Wall Street's fear gauge, experienced its sharpest single-day surge since the market turmoil of 2020.
